study_access_guards: Experiment blocked historical holdout/model/result reads, checked exact raw fitting and validation rows, native model recipes and labels, and training-only scaler/sampler inputs. Native target counts, fixed neighborhoods, boundary anchors and genuine minority preservation were asserted. Tomek removal membership was reconstructed from mutual-neighbor links and restricted to quality5/6 training rows. Joint sampler choice used inner scores only; outer prediction reuse and all reported metrics were reconstructed from saved evidence.
